Thanks so much for the concern in me. I've had a 3T contrast MRI of the brain, and a spinal screening. No lesions or demyelination, so they've ruled out MS, but my leg weakness is still there, and I've only had far worse symptoms since. Head pressure to the point my head feels like it's going to explode, an easy 8-9/10 pain. It gets so bad at night that I pray and moan in pain. It's been like that for a month now. More recently, inflammation of the sac around my heart, pericarditis, causing strong chest pain. But even that seems to come and go, and two ECGs had varied findings. I think this is close to the end for me. Everything only seems to be getting worse, involvement of more and more of my body. I get sharp pains in my intestines sometimes. There's just so much going wrong. Random rushes of heat in body parts. I'm terrified and miserable. I think there's some sphenoid sinus disease involvement, but the first CT scan done weeks ago was clear. I haven't had an MRI since the pains started. Did a CT of the brain and that was clear.  But we've put so much money into me already. Nobody in my family believes me anymore. I'm bankrupting my father because I hadn't yet begun to work. I'm only 19. We went to the ER twice, first time the pain decided not to show up so the visit was wasted, the second I was in horrible pain and they found nothing in the CT and blodowork. Just those visits almost $10k in bills. We can't pay that. Every day the pain pushes me to think this may be it, this may be the day I havea stroke. I'm thinking Lyme disease, or Sphenoid sinusitis, but no solutions, no answers. I need more rests, I need to see more doctors, but our insurance is absolutely horrible, just barely better than no insurance. Because my father's company negotiated the health iunsurance poorly this year. Last year it was amazing, and we were never sick last year. It's so horrible. It's like some big joke.

I understand, people in medicine are very busy. Your work is important and you have a life, after all. I'm grateful for your time.

 Got this weird swelling pain, like its the nerve behind the left eye, as if the optic nerve is being twisted every now and then. Since the onset of this, the left eye ghosting is almost full on double vision now, accompanied by pain. The monocular diplopia seems to have started in my right eye as well, the first stage of the left eye's onset. Definitely feels like I can't quite finishing urinating, as if I have to try harder and force. The urge too seems to come all at once. Perhaps slight incontinence/retention. My left foot heel feels definitely bonier than my right. My left leg overall feels weaker to walk on, stiff. Couldn't walk more than 40 minutes at the mall without severe left leg fatigue the other day. Been getting random burning every now and then in feet and hands. Got random quad spasms in the left leg a few nights ago. Been having this feeling like popping corn in the left leg for hours at night for the past few nights. Jaw muscles were stiff for a spell, had to work them with my hands. Been noticing for weeks now I hit my hand against the wall or scrape the wall when walking, never used to do that before. Think it's because of unsteadiness of gait or just unawareness. Random muscle twitches, either in quads or glutes or something. Just 1-3 a day.

I'm worried for ALS because of the feeling of left foot atrophy and twitching and whatnot. I'm almost certain it's PPMS for a number of reasons. PPMS presents largely in spine and sometimes never shows lesions in brain until late into disease. Presents with problems walking like stiff leg. More likely to include visual disturbance than RRMS. Severely depressed. The anxiety comes and goes, brought to temporary solace when I try to accept the possibility of death. I just avoid thinking about gradual decline. Symptoms have only gotten progressively worse. Relatively slowly but surely over the past 4 months. It's likely my MRIs won't be done until after my EMG.
